title: Live console Sprint page is hard-coded to sprint-04
description: Evidence: apps/console/src/app/live-data.ts defaults sprintLabel to sprint-04 and queries work list by that label; apps/console/src/server.ts exposes no sprint-label option. Impact: /sprint shows wrong or empty work in repos whose active sprint is not sprint-04.
acceptanceCriteria: Live sprint loading uses the active sprint/current sprint source or an explicit route/server parameter instead of hard-coded sprint-04, with coverage for a non-sprint-04 workspace.
